summary: Encourages researchers to contribute their results to internet standardization and explains how to do so. It describes how academic work has shaped Internet technology, and how the IETF and the Internet Research Task Force can use outside input. It is informational guidance, not a protocol.

eli5.summary: Scientists often invent smart ideas about the internet. This guide is a how-to for taking those ideas to the group that writes the rules, so they can become real.

questions: how can researchers contribute to ietf
how to get research into internet standards
